articles.headline: Bangladesh Dengue Death Toll Rises
articles.brief: The death toll from dengue in Bangladesh continues to surge. Health officials indicate that the crisis is unlikely to ease significantly before December.

articles.headline: Binance Replenishes Stolen Assets
articles.brief: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has successfully replenished ninety percent of the digital assets that were compromised and stolen during a recent major security incident.

articles.headline: France Braces For Fresh Unrest
articles.brief: The French government has vowed to take a tough stance as the country braces itself for fresh rounds of public unrest and widespread demonstrations.

articles.headline: Nasdaq Faces Trillion-Dollar Wipeout
articles.brief: The Nasdaq index faces a staggering two trillion dollar wipeout during October as growing anxieties and fears regarding corporate artificial intelligence spending deepen.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh Braces For Cyclone
articles.brief: Authorities in Andhra Pradesh have been placed on high alert as a depression over the southeast Bay of Bengal is forecasted to intensify into a cyclone.

articles.headline: Quad Expresses Economic Coercion Concerns
articles.brief: Ministers from the Quad alliance meeting in Georgia have expressed grave concerns regarding global economic coercion, including the use of arbitrary export restrictions.

articles.headline: Centre Releases ₹1.09 Lakh Crore
articles.brief: The central government has released an additional installment of tax devolution amounting to 1.09 lakh crore rupees to various states across the country.

articles.headline: IBBI Notifies Developer Insolvency Rules
articles.brief: New regulations notified by the IBBI allow financial creditors to seek exemptions for healthy real estate projects from wider developer bankruptcy proceedings.

articles.headline: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Takes Charge
articles.brief: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit has officially taken charge as the new head of the Indian Air Force, bringing four decades of extensive service experience.

articles.headline: Cursor Confirms Claude Code Compromise
articles.brief: Code editor Cursor reported that up to 5,000 users were potentially affected following a security incident involving a tampered Claude Code extension.

articles.headline: Australia Slips In WTC Standings
articles.brief: Australia has dropped to third place in the World Test Championship standings after losing their hard-fought Test series 2-1 away to South Africa.

articles.headline: Delhi Imposes Strict Winter Pollution Curbs
articles.brief: Delhi has rolled out comprehensive winter pollution restrictions effective November 1, including fifty percent work-from-home mandates and heavily increased parking fees.

articles.headline: PM Modi Slams Opposition Parties
articles.brief: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched a scathing attack on the political opposition, accusing them of conspiring to divide the nation through foreign meetings.

articles.headline: INDIA Bloc Protests Voter Roll Revisions
articles.brief: The INDIA political bloc has escalated protests against the Election Commission, organizing a major rally in Delhi to contest recent electoral-roll revisions.

articles.headline: Navy Halts Railways To Enter Final
articles.brief: The Navy sports team delivered a stellar performance to defeat Railways, successfully ending their tournament title hopes and advancing directly to the final.
